sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Dark Pharaoh is a Blood Spiral Brotherhood Titan that was in the possession of Rassimov. [The Golden Asp]

Rassimov later gave Dark Pharaoh to one of his Suits. The Suit invoked the Titan in an ambush to the Huntik Team in the midst of a sandstorm. Dante Vale invoked Solwing in response, making Dark Pharaoh shoot one of its spheres toward Dante's Titan, but missed. Shortly after, Dark Pharaoh shot at a turned-away Caliban, and incapacitated the Titan for a short period of time. Dante cast Touchram at the dark Titan and sent it back to its amulet. [The Golden Asp]

The same Suit invoked Dark Pharaoh to participate in the large battle in King Solomon's Mines. Dark Pharaoh fought Feyone but was unable to hurt Sophie's Titan, being sent back to its amulet shortly after by Tao, at the command of Lok.[To Be Together]

A Dark Pharaoh Titan was in the possession of Omeed, an Organization operative. [TCG:LGS-044]

A Casterwill Hunter invoked a Dark Pharaoh Titan to attack Powerbonded Caliban and Ironsquire. Ultimately, Dark Pharaoh and Ironsquire defeated each other. [The Casterwill Connection]

A Casterwill Hunter invoked Dark Pharaoh to attack Lok Lambert and Powerbonded Kipperin. Dark Pharaoh then fought Powerbonded Sabriel and Sophie Casterwill. [The Dead Magic Island]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Dark Pharaoh can pull air into his ethereal body through the nose-like structure on his face; however, most [[Seekers]] believe he pulls more than air from his enemies. Many believe he can consume courage, strength, and power, as well as happiness. Dark Pharaoh's '''Sandsweep''' ability lets him glide through the air and fire balls of sand at enemies.

full_text:
Dark Pharaoh is a mysterious four-eyed Titan. He levitates across the battlefield, striking fear into the hearts of his enemies. This Titan has no arms, but that doesn't mean it doesn't pack a powerful punch, so to speak.

==History==
Dark Pharaoh is a Blood Spiral Brotherhood Titan that was in the possession of Rassimov. [The Golden Asp]

Rassimov later gave Dark Pharaoh to one of his Suits. The Suit invoked the Titan in an ambush to the Huntik Team in the midst of a sandstorm. Dante Vale invoked Solwing in response, making Dark Pharaoh shoot one of its spheres toward Dante's Titan, but missed. Shortly after, Dark Pharaoh shot at a turned-away Caliban, and incapacitated the Titan for a short period of time. Dante cast Touchram at the dark Titan and sent it back to its amulet. [The Golden Asp]

The same Suit invoked Dark Pharaoh to participate in the large battle in King Solomon's Mines. Dark Pharaoh fought Feyone but was unable to hurt Sophie's Titan, being sent back to its amulet shortly after by Tao, at the command of Lok.[To Be Together]

A Dark Pharaoh Titan was in the possession of Omeed, an Organization operative. [TCG:LGS-044]

A Casterwill Hunter invoked a Dark Pharaoh Titan to attack Powerbonded Caliban and Ironsquire. Ultimately, Dark Pharaoh and Ironsquire defeated each other. [The Casterwill Connection]

A Casterwill Hunter invoked Dark Pharaoh to attack Lok Lambert and Powerbonded Kipperin. Dark Pharaoh then fought Powerbonded Sabriel and Sophie Casterwill. [The Dead Magic Island]

==Abilities==
Dark Pharaoh can pull air into his ethereal body through the nose-like structure on his face; however, most Seekers believe he pulls more than air from his enemies. Many believe he can consume courage, strength, and power, as well as happiness. Dark Pharaoh's Sandsweep ability lets him glide through the air and fire balls of sand at enemies.
